name: Reciprocating gas compressor frames
description: Positive-displacement compression where high pressure ratio, turndown or intermittent duty is required. Ariel frames are separable, engine- or motor-driven, with high-pressure cylinders for gas lift, gas reinjection and CNG; large frames are recommended for pipeline transmission and high-pressure injection.

specifications.basis: Ariel JGN/JGQ, 1 throw JGN 126 BHP @1500 rpm, JGQ 140 BHP @1800 rpm; 2 throw JGN 252 BHP, JGQ 280 BHP. Rod load 18,000-20,000 lb; stroke 3.5 in (JGN) / 3.0 in (JGQ)
Ariel KBB/KBV, 4-throw 6668 BHP and 6-throw 10,000 BHP; stroke 7.25 in (KBB) / 8.50 in (KBV); total rod load 190,000 lb; max 900/750 rpm
Howden / Peter Brotherhood reciprocating compressors rated to 20 MW, operating 260-1000 rpm
Ariel '70,000+ compressors manufactured since 1966'; 550+ cylinder-to-frame combinations
Ariel process/refining/chemical compressors 'rod load up to 10,000 lbs'
